description: The pages inside one section, optionally only addresses containing a word. Use after etfiq_sections, then etfiq_page. count is the whole matching set even when the list is capped.

contains.description: Optional: only addresses containing this text, case-insensitive.

limit.description: Most addresses to return. Default 100, at most 500.

section.description: A section name from etfiq_sections, such as rankings or funds. Letters only.

name: etfiq_list

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
